decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor still has uncertain but promising demand and low carrying cost, so the option remains worth keeping.
The voltage measurement module is a core input option with steady demand, so its option has resolved favorably and it is very unlikely to be dropped.
CAN bus is a widely used industrial interface with ongoing demand, making the option still valuable to retain.
The CO2 sensor addresses growing ventilation and air-quality monitoring demand, so its option value remains positive.
